build_model_mobilevit: build a MobileViT model for image classification with custom image size, channels, and number of classes
create_transformer_block: create a Transformer block with attention and feedforward layers for sequence modeling
create_attention_layer: create a multi-head self-attention layer with configurable heads, dim_head, and dropout
create_mv2_block: create a MobileNetV2-style inverted residual block with depthwise and pointwise convolutions
create_mobilevit_block: create a MobileViT block that combines local convolutions with global transformer attention
